null_and_control_freeze.reason: Phase-A T5 is satisfied with preregistered matched controls already present in the frozen operator experiment: input-only, one-sided A/B, direct-pair, one-step A, identity-return baseline, swapped order, and collapsed incoming-state controls. No stochastic null is generated.

candidate_specs.feature_definition: A four-center anonymous path u-v-w-x supplies two ordered two-port operators A and B and boundary states s0,s1,s2; test whether the frozen one-step kernels compose as K_A K_B.
candidate_specs.preconditions: Simple four-center path; both operators pass train-only support thresholds; boundary states map through the train-frozen state vocabulary.
candidate_specs.operational_delta: The consequence distribution for s2 after A then B is the matrix product of the frozen one-step consequence kernels, without direct pair refitting.
residual_unexplained_features: Recursive nesting, filled-region enclosure, and direct split/join mutation are not claimed by this candidate.

candidate_specs.feature_definition: For a train-supported anonymous operator A, test whether repeating A produces a consequence kernel indistinguishable within the frozen tolerance from one application of A.
candidate_specs.preconditions: A,A pair meets train occurrence/source thresholds and train kernel total-variation threshold.
candidate_specs.operational_delta: A followed by A preserves the one-step A consequence relation within the frozen holdout log-loss tolerance.
residual_unexplained_features: This is operator repetition, not a claim that every repeated physical mark is idempotent.

candidate_specs.feature_definition: For a train-supported ordered pair A,B, test whether the composite returns the outgoing boundary toward the incoming boundary state more strongly than either operator alone.
candidate_specs.preconditions: A,B meets train pair support and frozen train identity-return/gain thresholds.
candidate_specs.operational_delta: A then B increases exact boundary-state return relative to frozen single-operator and input-only controls.
residual_unexplained_features: A positive result is operational cancellation only; it does not assign inverse semantics or historical meaning.

candidate_specs.feature_definition: For train-supported A,B and B,A, test whether reversing operator order changes the frozen consequence kernel and whether each observed order predicts its own held-out consequences better than the swapped order.
candidate_specs.preconditions: Both orders independently meet train support; the train kernel total-variation distance clears the frozen threshold.
candidate_specs.operational_delta: A then B and B then A are noncommutative at the frozen anonymous boundary-state resolution.
residual_unexplained_features: Order sensitivity is not a directional reading or semantic sequence.

candidate_specs.feature_definition: For a fixed train-supported A,B pair, test whether different incoming anonymous boundary states stably select different outgoing consequence states.
candidate_specs.preconditions: At least two train-supported incoming states have different dominant outgoing states above the frozen dominance threshold.
candidate_specs.operational_delta: The same A,B composition has a held-out consequence conditioned by incoming structural state rather than a single pair-level output.
residual_unexplained_features: The incoming state is anonymous physical interface structure, not a lexical or semantic context.
